## The study

Yoon H, Nakouzi A, Pappas PG, Hemmige VS, Pirofski L. Specific and non-specific antibody profiles in organ transplant recipients with and without cryptococcosis. *Open Forum Infectious Diseases*. 2022;9(7):ofac211 [@yoon2022antibody].

-   **Liise-anne Pirofski** (principal investigator)
-   **Hyunah Yoon** (first author)
-   **Vagish Hemmige** (statistical analysis and this repository)

## This repository

The analysis was originally written as a single R Markdown file in 2022. This repository splits that file into scripts run in order by `R/main.R` and documents each step on this website. The analysis code is unchanged; the additions are the data path in `R/setup.R`, the names that results are assigned to, and the code that exports tables and figures. The study data are restricted and are not in the repository.

Contributions follow the rules in [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Pirofski-cryptococcus-study/blob/master/AGENTS.md); open questions and known issues are tracked in [Issues](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Pirofski-cryptococcus-study/issues).

## Pages

-   [**Clinical background**](background.qmd): the clinical question and study design.
-   [**Setup**](setup.qmd): packages and the location of the study data.
-   [**Functions**](functions.qmd): helpers that summarize and export tables.
-   [**1. Import and clean data**](import_clean.qmd): reads the workbook, derives variables, applies the exclusion.
-   [**2. Regression, ROC and cutpoints**](modeling.qmd): logistic regression models, ROC curves, AUC confidence intervals and optimal titer cutpoints.
-   [**3. Principal component analysis**](pca.qmd): PCA of the log antibody levels and regression on the components.
-   [**Tables**](tables.qmd): Table 1 and the export of every table.
-   [**Figures**](figures.qmd): every figure and its export.
-   [**Results**](results.qmd): the exported tables and figures.
